meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: Claude 能用它自动操作浏览器：打开网页、点击元素、填写表单、截屏、提取页面信息，并通过快照编号定位页面元素。
howto.when: 当用户需要浏览网页、填写表单、截图等浏览器操作时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并给整页截图
在这个页面上找到登录按钮并点击
say.note: Claude 通过快照定位按钮并执行点击。

say.text: 提取当前页面的标题和所有链接

howto.what_en: Claude can use it to automate a browser: open pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract page info, and locate elements via snapshot refs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user needs browser operations like opening pages, filling forms, taking screenshots, etc.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot
say_en.note: The screenshot will be saved to a file.

say_en.text: Find the login button on this page and click it
say_en.note: Claude locates the button via snapshot and clicks it.

say_en.text: Extract the title and all links from the current page
say_en.note: Returns the title and a list of links.
